KCB OUTCOME CODES (v1) — the only valid vocabulary.

Codes are case-sensitive; omit reason EXACTLY where the sheet lists "none".

PTP: (no reason)
No-PTP: R07
DEC: F01 | F02
VOID: RNG | JCB-unclear
transferred: kcb_person

add_note is not used by call sheet KCB-1. schedule_callback is not used. transfer_to_agent uses queue kcb_desk only.
